headline: Principal. Coupons. Maturity.
body: Separate the money invested, scheduled interest, and principal due at the end.

bond.exampleNote: Hypothetical units and dates, not an actual BNR issue. Timeline spacing is not to scale.
bond.footnote: Assumes purchase at face value, payments made as promised, and no costs or taxes. Principal repayment is not coupon income. A schedule is not proof of receipt or a guaranteed return.
bond.source: Reference: Struct Capital bond learning guides
